title: Text handling: grapheme truncation helper, display-text profile check, normalization/collation/time-zone audits
description:
Text handling (draft section "Text Handling in JMAP"):
- jmap-types `text` module:
  - `truncate_graphemes(s, max_octets) -> &str`: cut at the last extended grapheme cluster boundary within the octet limit (UAX 29; decision .1(g)).
  - `check_display_text(s, multiline) -> Result`: rejects C0/C1 controls except LF in multi-line text, U+2028/2029, U+FFFE/FFFF, and a leading U+FEFF. Servers MAY use it to reject with invalidProperties.
- Replace the code-point-only truncation at crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs:698 (push payload) and crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs:1540 (preview) with truncate_graphemes. Grep for other is_char_boundary truncation loops.
- Audit: no server normalizes stored text, except where the spec requires it (Mailbox Net-Unicode). Find any nfc()/to_lowercase stored back.
- Audit: text filters compare with the collation used for sorting that property (mail memory/mod.rs:2295 area, filenode, metadata, graph, sharing).
- Audit: time-zone-valued properties are IANA ids.
- Each finding that is a behavior change gets a CHANGELOG line.
